user.title: MyGarage
user.description: Connect to your self-hosted MyGarage instance. Create a Widget API key (`mgwk_…`) in MyGarage Settings → Integrations. Optional webhook token enables write services; optional username/password enable LiveLink and reminder entities.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to MyGarage. Check the URL and that the instance is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the widget API key and optional username/password. Widget keys require MyGarage auth mode `local` or `oidc` (not `none`).
error.webhook_not_configured: MyGarage returned 503 — webhook ingest token may not be configured on the server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This MyGarage instance is already configured.

init.title: MyGarage options
init.description: Update credentials and poll interval (default 60s; widget API is rate-limited to 60 requests/minute).

log_fuel.name: Log fuel
log_fuel.description: Log a fuel fill-up or EV charge via webhook.

log_odometer.name: Log odometer
log_odometer.description: Log an odometer reading via webhook.

complete_reminder.name: Complete reminder
complete_reminder.description: Mark a reminder complete via webhook.
